name: Chat Completions — Web search variant
summary: POST /v1/chat/completions with `model:"gpt-5-search-api"` — a dedicated model that always performs a web search before responding, preserving the Chat Completions shape for legacy callers.
description: OpenAI exposes a special model variant (`gpt-5-search-api`) on the legacy Chat Completions endpoint that unconditionally executes a web search before responding. Unlike the Responses API `web_search` tool, there is no tool config; the behavior is entirely selected by the `model` string. This raises a specific BYOM question: even if the caller supplies `{gateway_connection}/gpt-5-search-api` as the model, does the upstream (OpenAI via APIM, or an APIM-fronted equivalent) actually run the search, and are results attributed correctly? Not yet tested.
notes: Status-only. Distinct from `tool-web-search` (which covers the Responses API tool attached to a Prompt Agent).
